summary: Iteration 15 verification: (a) Stripe hosted Payment Links, (b) industrialized Funnel Builder (9 new block types + 5 new templates + opt-in capture), (c) regression on the 9 deferred iter-14 fixes. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_stripe_industrial.py — 29/29 PASS; prior suites test_iter14_batch5.py + test_iter13_hydration.py re-run 37/37 PASS. Frontend: Playwright verified /pricing Stripe redirects (anon + authenticated), all 9 industrial blocks rendering on a public funnel, live opt-in submission, categorized editor palette with all 9 add-block-<type> buttons, analytics-optin-submits badge, clipboard-denial resilience, exactly-one view event per page load, and $39.20/$49.00 strike-through on qa-storefront-live. Two real defects found: invisible CTA buttons on /c/{code} (white-on-white) and missing property editors for all 9 new block types in the funnel editor.

minor.issue: Ownership guard uses `await find_one(...) or (_ for _ in ()).throw(HTTPException(404))` and does not filter `is_deleted`, so leads of a soft-deleted funnel are still readable. Works but is an unreadable idiom — replace with an explicit if/raise plus `is_deleted: {$ne: True}`.

The raw `funnels.views` counter is incremented on every public API GET (server-side, incl. bots/pytest) while analytics prefers the client `view` event count. The two diverge (qa-storefront-live: funnels.views=39 vs event views=23). Not a bug per spec, but the dashboard number is ambiguous.

ui_bugs.issue: CTA buttons are completely invisible — contrast ratio 1:1. 'Claim Offer' renders color rgb(255,255,255) on background rgb(255,255,255); 'Copy' renders color rgb(10,10,10) on background rgb(10,10,10). RCA: PublicCoupon.js hardcodes `text-white` on the redeem button (style background = `bg` = design.accent || brand.primary_color || '#005CEE') and `color:'#0A0A0A'` on the copy button (background = `accent` = brand.secondary_color). The seeded workspace brand is primary_color '#FFFFFF' / secondary_color '#0A0A0A', so both buttons collapse. Fix: compute foreground from background luminance (e.g. YIQ/relative-luminance helper) instead of hardcoding. Reproduce: https://campaign-hub-436.preview.emergentagent.com/c/TESTCTAEMPTY01 (and VIPELITJRIXE — same workspace brand).

None of the 9 new industrial block types have a property editor. Funnels.js only renders prop inputs for image/video/audio/countdown/product/row/hero/coupon/giftcard/cta/testimonial/heading/paragraph/features/faq. logo_bar, stats, guarantee, pricing_table, order_bump, upsell, optin, spacer and divider render only the BG/ACCENT swatches — merchants can add them but can never change headline, logos, stat values, pricing tiers, bump/upsell price, opt-in fields/lead_tag, or spacer height. This blocks the stated goal of 'industrialize the Funnel Builder to match systeme.io'.

Hero CTA 'Shop now' uses the block-level accent override #361b1b (dark maroon) with dark text — text is barely legible; the eyebrow 'NEW DROP · LIMITED STOCK' is also near-invisible on #0A0A0A. Same root cause as the coupon page: accent-driven buttons never compute a contrasting foreground.

issues: Logo names (Forbes/TechCrunch/Wired) render in a very dim gray on near-black; contrast is below WCAG AA for the size used.

critical_code_review_comments: PublicCoupon.js: button text colours are hardcoded ('text-white' / '#0A0A0A') while their backgrounds are dynamic brand colours — guaranteed contrast failures for white or near-black brand palettes. Derive fg from bg luminance.

Funnels.js editor renders a block-type-specific prop form via a chain of `b.type === '...'` conditionals; the 9 new types were added to the palette and to the public REGISTRY but never to this chain. Consider a config-driven schema map (type -> field list) so palette, defaults and editor cannot drift again.
funnels.py (830 lines) mixes 12 hardcoded templates with route handlers — move TEMPLATES to routers/funnel_templates.py.

trackFunnelEvent uses navigator.sendBeacon; verified working via DB event counts (exactly +1 view per page load), but note it is invisible to Playwright request interception — future agents should assert against /api/funnels/{fid}/analytics instead of network listeners.

rca_of_the_issue: Invisible CTAs on /c/{code}: PublicCoupon.js line ~148 sets the redeem button style to `{background: bg}` with className 'text-white', where bg = design.accent || brand.primary_color || '#005CEE'. The seeded workspace brand primary_color is '#FFFFFF', so white text lands on a white button. Symmetrically the copy button at line ~130 uses `{background: accent, color: '#0A0A0A'}` where accent falls back to brand.secondary_color '#0A0A0A'. Confirmed via getComputedStyle: redeem = color rgb(255,255,255) / bg rgb(255,255,255); copy = color rgb(10,10,10) / bg rgb(10,10,10). Mitigation: add a getContrastText(hex) helper (relative luminance > 0.5 -> '#0A0A0A' else '#FFFFFF') and apply it to every dynamically-coloured button in PublicCoupon.js and PublicFunnel.js/PublicFunnelIndustrial.js.
